short: A sweeping political reorganization that dismantled old aristocratic power networks and established the world's first true democracy.
full:
Following the expulsion of the Peisistratid tyrants and a brief struggle with Spartan-backed oligarchs, Cleisthenes took power with the support of the Athenian masses. He radically restructured the citizen body, replacing the four traditional kinship tribes with ten new ones based on demes (local geographic units) distributed across the city, coast, and inland areas.

This deliberate mixing fractured the regional power bases of aristocratic families and integrated the citizenry. He also instituted the Council of 500, selected by lot, to prepare the agenda for the Assembly, and introduced ostracism to prevent future tyrants. Together, these reforms effectively established isonomia (equality before the law) and birthed classical Athenian democracy.
